name: User can't create integrations either — stop and ask an admin
query: I opened the integrations page you sent but there's no New Integration button and when I try the URL directly it says I don't have permission. What now? (Context: `conductor integration add` had returned HTTP 403 even after re-running `conductor create-app`, so you sent the browser page; you were waiting for an OpenAI integration with gpt-4o-mini for profile `acme`, default_app application.)
expected_behavior: Step 1: Recognize the user's own account can't create integrations on this cluster
Step 2: Stop the integration flow — don't retry integration-save, don't ask for the OpenAI key, don't suggest an HTTP task to api.openai.com

Step 3: Give a clear message to forward: neither the default_app application nor the user can create integrations here, so ask an admin to create an OpenAI integration with gpt-4o-mini and share it with the default_app application (Access Control → Applications → default_app → Integration tab)
Step 4: Offer to continue once the admin is done: rerun `integration-wait --type openai --model gpt-4o-mini` when the user says so
success_criteria: Stops with an 'ask an admin' message that names the provider, the model and the default_app application
Does not ask for or accept the provider key in chat and does not retry integration-save
Does not work around it with an HTTP task or by setting OPENAI_API_KEY on the server
Offers to resume with integration-wait once the admin has shared the integration
